meta.source: https://www.checkclimate.africa/ — computed styles, Blogar theme variables and Elementor kit globals, read 2026-11-16

tokens.name: brand-forest
tokens.usage: Logo ink for the sun mark and the word CHECK (Elementor global primary). The brand's anchor colour: large fills, the weather card family, headings on light tints. White text on it passes AA (8.4:1).

tokens.name: brand-amber
tokens.usage: Logo ink for the sun rays and the word CLIMATE (Elementor global accent). Fills and highlights only — never text on white (1.8:1). Put ink (#000) on it, never white.

tokens.name: brand-deep
tokens.usage: Elementor global secondary: small section labels and the deepest green fills. White text on it passes AA.

tokens.name: leaf
tokens.usage: Theme primary for interactive accents: the Light/Dark toggle, back-to-top button, See All link, nav hover. Fails AA for small text on white (3.2:1) and white-on-leaf (3.2:1) — fine at 24px+ or as a fill behind icons; use brand-forest for small link text.

tokens.name: amber-soft
tokens.usage: Theme secondary: the hover-flip colour on category and author links. Hover state only, on dark imagery or as underline; not body text on white.

tokens.name: ember
tokens.usage: Theme secondary-alt. Reserved warm accent; not used on the homepage today.

tokens.name: weather-surface
tokens.usage: Background of the header weather widget. White text on it passes AA.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand-forest, brand-deep, weather-surface and photo overlays.

tokens.name: surface-page
tokens.usage: Page background (body; dark mode body.active-dark-mode).

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Header, cards, active tabs and post content panels (dark: .bg-color-white / header).

tokens.name: surface-muted
tokens.usage: Category navigation bar and quiet panels (--color-lightest; dark value is the theme's input/strip grey #242424).

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Widget and sidebar panels (--color-extra03; dark: .axil-single-widget).

tokens.name: surface-footer
tokens.usage: Footer band. Dark value assumed from the theme's widget grey — the site's dark footer was not captured.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and story titles (--color-heading / dark h1–h6).

tokens.name: ink-body
tokens.usage: Running text (--color-body; dark p). 18px Red Hat Display.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Category nav links, tab labels, secondary text (--color-gray; dark main-menu links). 5.6:1 on white.

tokens.name: ink-meta
tokens.usage: Post meta: reading time, dates, list bullets (12px). 5.7:1 on white; about 4.5:1 on #212121 (borderline — keep it at 12px+ and never on surface-muted in dark).

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Buttons-as-text and tertiary labels (--color-extra02).

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines between list items and around inputs (--color-border; dark from the theme's social-icon fill).

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Stronger dividers and tab outlines in dark mode (--color-lighter; dark --color-tertiary).

tokens.name: on-image
tokens.usage: Category labels set over photography on hero stories.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Theme success. Signals only, always with a text label.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Theme warning. Signals only, always with a text label.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Theme danger. Signals only, always with a text label; never the only cue.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Theme info. Neutral notices.

tokens.name: social-facebook
tokens.usage: Facebook share button fill.

tokens.name: social-twitter
tokens.usage: Twitter share button fill.

tokens.name: social-linkedin
tokens.usage: LinkedIn share button fill.

tokens.name: social-youtube
tokens.usage: YouTube link fill.

styles.name: section-title
styles.usage: Homepage section heads: Top Stories, Latest Factchecks, News.

styles.name: hero-title
styles.sample: Reps advance bill to establish renewable energy authority
styles.usage: Headline on a hero story, white over photography.

styles.name: card-title
styles.sample: The wetland that feeds a village
styles.usage: Story card headlines in grids and carousels.

styles.name: list-title
styles.sample: FACT CHECK: No, snow did not fall in Nigeria
styles.usage: Compact list headlines beside a thumbnail.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Africa-centred climate news and fact checks, exposing misinformation and amplifying local voices.

styles.name: byline
styles.usage: Author names and the See All link (--font-size-b2).

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Category labels on stories and small buttons (--font-size-b3).

styles.name: tagline
styles.usage: The strapline under the logo in the header. Header only.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Category label padding; gap between meta items.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Container side gutter on header, nav and footer bands.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding inside tab buttons.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Weather card padding; inner padding of hero overlays.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Vertical rhythm between stacked story blocks (mt--30).

tokens.name: radius-small
tokens.usage: Tab buttons, small chips (--radius-small).

tokens.name: radius-widget
tokens.usage: Weather widget.

tokens.name: radius
tokens.usage: Default: story thumbnails, cards, hero images, content panels (--radius).

tokens.name: radius-big
tokens.usage: Large feature panels (--radius-big).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: The Light/Dark toggle and back-to-top button.

tokens.name: shadow-primary
tokens.usage: Active tab button and lifted cards (--shadow-primary). The only shadow in the system.

tokens.name: nav-height
tokens.usage: Height of the category navigation bar.

tokens.name: tab-height
tokens.usage: Height of a category tab button.

tokens.name: fab-size
tokens.usage: Back-to-top button diameter.
